simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to מִזָּה (H4199) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: מִזָּה (Mizzâh) means Mizzah , an Edomite First listed occurrence: 1Chr 1 37.

definitions.full: H4199. Mizzah מִזָּה proper name, masculine grandson of Esau Gen 36:13 , 17 ( ᵐ5 Μοζε ); 1Chr 1:37 ( ᵐ5 Ομοζε , ᵐ5 L Μαζε ). [ מָ֫זוּ ], מְזָוֵינוּ see זוה . מְזוּזָה see זוז . מָזוֺן see זון . I. מָזוֺר see III. זוּר II. מָזוֺר see II. מזר infra. below
definitions.rootNote: probably from an unused root meaning to faint with fear; terror ;
